title: Aranmanai Kavalan
desc: Sakthi takes upon himself to protect and fight for every Tamilian thriving in Mumbai. When he meets the wife of the late community-chief, he makes up his mind to resolve her family issues.

title: Thanga Manasukkaran
desc: Chellakili and Murugan are long-lost lovers who unite when Murugan visits her village disguised as a musician, Murugesh. Chellakili's aunt then devises a sinister plot to separate them.

title: Sivasakthi
desc: Sakthi, a police officer, befriends Siva, a smuggler, in order to gain his trust and get evidence against him. But soon, their friendship turns into a genuine one.

title: Agal Vilakku
desc: Navaneetham and Dhanushkodi get married despite their family's disapproval. Later, when he becomes the mayor, his family accepts bribes and puts the blame on Navaneetham.

title: Eera Nilam
desc: A woman's sons go to the Kargil war and get martyred. Later, the younger son takes the responsibility of supporting his family.
